V. 2. 22</ls>] Formed by walking together seven steps, or by talking together seven words; यतः सतां संनतगात्रि संगतं मनीषिभिः साप्तपदीनमुच्यते <ls>Ku. 5. 39</ls> (where the latter sense appears better); सतां साप्तपदं मैत्रमित्याहुर्विबुधा जनाः <ls>Pt. 2. 43</ls>, <ls n="Pt.">4. 103</ls>. .{@-दम्, -दीनम्@} .²1 Circumambulation of the nuptial fire by the bride and bridegroom in seven steps (which makes the marriage tie irrevocable). .²2 Friendship, intimacy.
